chapter_title_en: The Return to the Mortal World
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch. 275: Xiao Chen Returns to the Mortal World
chapter_meta_description: After over a year sealed in stone, Xiao Chen awakens. Half-ancestors leave blessings, Qingqing is injured, and he is pulled back to the Mortal World.
og_title: World of Immortality Ch. 275: The Stone Shatters, the River Calls
og_description: Keke's vigil ends. Xiao Chen emerges from the stone statue, and a space vortex sends him back to the Yellow River—home.
twitter_title: WIM Ch. 275: Xiao Chen Returns Home
twitter_description: After being imprisoned for months, Xiao Chen breaks free and is transported to the Mortal World.
